reason: The reviewed public proposition, two audience paths and Precision Instrument presentation are coherent. The supplied desktop hero and full mobile capture show clear hierarchy, consistent numbered structure and explicit client/student actions. Client terms explain cost, semester length, team and confidentiality; absent case studies are not fabricated. Canonical/social metadata and private noindex defaults have useful local evidence. However, a recruitment service error becomes an asserted publication state and removes the application action. That is a material information failure for a deadline-driven student journey. Hold for truthful outage handling and focused verification. This is an independent simulated AI lens, not human endorsement or observed user success; the broad world-class claim also exceeds the supplied local integration and usability evidence.

findings.evidence: fetchPublicRecruitment discards the RPC error and returns {cycle:null} when data is absent. Join defaults events to [], renders “The Board has not published events for this cycle yet,” and replaces Apply with Get recruitment updates. Thus an RPC failure with null data is indistinguishable from genuinely unpublished recruitment. public-journeys.spec.ts:30-37 tests preparation discovery, not this failure branch.
findings.userImpact: During a recruitment outage, a student can infer that no events/application opportunity exists, join an updates list instead of applying, and miss a live deadline. The page attributes missing information to the Board without evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Return distinct available/unavailable recruitment states. On failure, state that live dates could not be checked, offer retry and the board email, and preserve a route to check application availability. Render unpublished-event copy only after a successful empty response. Add focused outage-versus-empty journey coverage.

notVerified: No staging, hosted integration or human study exists. Clerk sessions, actual RPC/RLS/storage behavior, contact email delivery and recruitment notification operations are unverified.
Traced the client journey from Work terms through Contact to API/email source; the recorded browser confirmation intercepts /api/contact with a synthetic 200 and does not prove delivery.

Publication result confirms synthetic post-build publication, rendered OG/Twitter PNGs and withdrawn page 404. The script does not request image URLs after withdrawal or verify sitemap/index cache expiry; hosted withdrawal and external crawler/social cache behavior remain unknown.
Original-resume access is explicitly disclosed in application materials/review copy; actual reviewer access enforcement was not exercised by this seat.

No independent validation of organization statistics, client approvals, physical-device/assistive-technology behavior or real student/client task success. Private grading/operator workflows were outside this focal inspection.
